desc: Back to the launcher by controller (TTYD_BINDINGS_TEST: a virtual controller as player 1, in Rogueport): Back held then Start, the defaults' combo, asks the launcher's question on the settings page; the game sees no Start while both are held, nor after Back is let go first with Start still down (no pause menu); Back's own release opens no Settings; then Back + Y takes a screenshot with Y not the game's. The test's earlier steps (Back alone opens Settings on its release, the photo combo) still pass
